objective: Complete the dependency-free standalone coding and focused-test phase of the inactive Governed Agent Team Conservative MVP Revision 3, freeze an independently reviewed implementation hash, and prepare an exact conformance handoff without accessing DSH or executing the unresolved dynamic conformance CLI.
non_goals: Do not access, install into, patch, build, restart, or modify any DSH checkout or live Web profile.
Do not install or resolve npm/pnpm dependencies, read an external package store, use ambient DSH executables, or use network access.

Do not execute or claim the proposal section-18 conformance command until the frozen implementation hash is inserted literally into a separately reviewed WBS command ending at .artifacts/gat-conformance/<implementation-hash>/.
Do not claim conformance, DSH integration, proposal approval, activation, or production readiness from focused standalone tests.
Do not implement broad Web UI, semantic/vector retrieval, caches, mission-shared memory, promotion, distributed 2PC, or MissionMembership.
Do not close AIP-EXEC-004 at this phase; leave it explicitly awaiting the reviewed conformance WBS.

requirements.acceptance: Before product work, prove no prior writer remains, preserve and settle attempt-core-007 without regaining its charge, select exact revision 15, and re-plan AIP-EXEC-004 in its fixed Workspace.

Before coding, an independent Security reviewer and HUMAN accept exact hashes for the proposal-required threat model and a baseline containing every unique section-18.1 GAT-* vector; HOLD or missing coverage blocks code.

Dependency-free ESM contracts model ProjectScope, principal-bound Desk, fixed Task/AIP/Workspace identity, readiness evidence, exact Team-plan approval, and conditional Mission approval without DSH imports or enforcement overclaims.

A deny-first PDP binds full immutable evidence to one physical selector, enforces account/workspace containment and response non-disclosure, has no decision/result cache, and produces zero backend calls for denied/stale requests.

Records/history enforce tenant IDs, source_refs, hashes, classification/redaction, retention/expiry, confidence/status/revision/idempotency and SoT-reference semantics; partitioned substring/get/write/revise/tombstone never broad-read post-filters.

Dependency-free code implements canonical audit chaining, monotonic append, anchor-before-publish, audit.read and sink failures, crash recovery, holds/purge, backup/restore non-resurrection, and zero committed/visible mutation on audit failure.

Only wrapper operations accept Agent data; selectors are out of band, raw MCP tool names are hidden and denied before PDP/MCP/backend access, unavailable capabilities fail closed, and returned references are provenance-labelled/untrusted.

A zero-dependency @deepseek-ai/dsh-gat ESM package has explicit exports/files, reproducible local Node-only build, focused source tests, and clean-process built import smoke without npm install, DSH, or ambient package tools.

Before implementation freeze, the zero-dependency package contains the exact test:conformance CLI and every-vector/raw-evidence runner, with focused unit tests for literal evidence-path use and evidence schema, but the accepted full baseline is not executed or claimed until a later exact-hash WBS.

A deterministic manifest hashes proposal, threat model, vector baseline, package manifest, every source/test/build script and built export; independent review confirms the hash and a handoff contains the exact future conformance evidence path with the literal hash.

Every task records evidence in the fixed Workspace, final capture/open-point sweep and scoped lint pass, HUMAN accepts the exact phase report/freeze, and AIP remains active only as awaiting a separately approved conformance WBS.
